bg.description: Window and page background, behind cards and glass. Plain: never a gradient or colour blobs.

surface.description: Cards, sheets, dialogs and the tint of glass panes. Solid: content never sits on see-through ground.

raised.description: Inputs, the off track of a switch, tiles inside a card.

sidebar.description: The floating sidebar and the Settings list.

border.description: Control outlines, hairlines between rows (in high contrast: every surface's outline).

hover.description: Hover and pressed fill of quiet buttons and list rows.

text.description: Body copy and titles on bg, surface, raised, sidebar and glass.

muted.description: Secondary words: hints under a setting, details under a title. On bg, surface and raised.

faint.description: Least important words that still must be read: captions, section labels. On bg and surface.

accent.description: The one action that matters, the chosen item, links, switches turned on, focus rings.

accent-soft.description: Tonal fills: the chosen tab or sidebar item, secondary buttons, the chosen segment.

danger.description: Deleting, errors, overdue. Always with a word or icon, never colour alone.

success.description: Done, saved, connected. Always with a word or icon.

warning.description: Needs attention soon: low battery, due today.
